events.title: Downtown Billings Holiday Parade
events.addr: N Broadway & 2nd Ave N, Billings, MT 59101
events.blurb: The 41st annual holiday parade loops through downtown on the Friday after Thanksgiving and ends with Santa's arrival. Photos with Santa run from 4:30 to 6 p.m. before the parade.
events.blurbEs: El 41.º desfile navideño anual recorre el centro el viernes después de Acción de Gracias y termina con la llegada de Santa. Antes del desfile hay fotos con Santa de 4:30 a 6 p. m.

events.title: Billings Symphony Presents The Nutcracker Ballet
events.blurb: Tchaikovsky's ballet with the Billings Symphony Orchestra playing live, San Diego Ballet and the Billings School of Classical Ballet. Three shows this weekend.
events.blurbEs: El ballet de Chaikovski con la Billings Symphony Orchestra en vivo, el San Diego Ballet y la Billings School of Classical Ballet. Tres funciones este fin de semana.
events.getThere: From I-90, take Exit 450 (27th Street) and head north about 1.5 miles, then turn left onto 3rd Avenue North; the theater is on the right.

events.title: Holiday Nights at ZooMontana
events.blurb: A walk-through light show at the zoo opens Friday for the season. Saturday is Nightmare Before Christmas night; tickets are sold by date and children 3 and under get in free.
events.blurbEs: Un recorrido a pie de luces en el zoológico que abre la temporada el viernes. El sábado es la noche de Nightmare Before Christmas; los boletos se venden por fecha y los niños de 3 años o menos entran gratis.

events.title: Yellowstone Art Museum
events.blurb: Contemporary art of Montana and the Rocky Mountain West, with current shows including Will James in Hollywood and Visions of America. Free for Yellowstone County residents and anyone 18 and under.
events.blurbEs: Arte contemporáneo de Montana y del oeste de las Montañas Rocosas, con exposiciones actuales como Will James in Hollywood y Visions of America. Gratis para residentes del condado de Yellowstone y menores de 18 años.

events.title: Western Heritage Center
events.blurb: A history museum of the Yellowstone River valley in a historic downtown building. Adults $8, students and seniors $5, under 6 free.
events.blurbEs: Un museo de historia del valle del río Yellowstone en un edificio histórico del centro. Adultos $8, estudiantes y mayores $5, menores de 6 gratis.
